title: Icon: Magic byte detection (file signature matching)

context_files.reason: File I/O security: read bounds, path validation

acceptance_criteria: magic_signature struct: byte pattern, mask, length, icon_codepoint
detect_magic(path) reads first 16 bytes of file
Matches common signatures: ELF (7F 45 4C 46), PNG (89 50 4E 47), PDF (25 50 44 46), ZIP (50 4B 03 04), GIF (47 49 46 38)
Returns icon codepoint when signature matched
Returns NULL when no signature matched (fall back to extension)
Handles unreadable files gracefully (permission denied, empty file)
Unit test verifies detection of 5+ file signatures
